basics.name: Sergio Márquez
basics.tagline: Backend & AI Engineer · Agents, RAG and LLMs in production
basics.summary: Backend & AI engineer based in Badajoz, Spain. At VITALY I design and ship LLM systems on Google Cloud: multi-agent assistants with RAG and voice, document validation with multimodal models, data pipelines and business automations. Outside work I build my own projects: voice and WhatsApp agents, image and video pipelines, a blog that publishes itself every day and the odd video game. I have coded with agents every day since 2024 (Claude Code and Codex) and I review with several models before critical changes.
basics.headline: I build AI agents and systems that make it to production.

status.label: AI agents and RAG in production

experience.summary: I design and ship LLM-based AI systems on Google Cloud, combining backend, data, evaluation and operations.
highlights: End-to-end owner of a multi-tenant conversational assistant in production, with a multi-agent architecture (Google ADK + LiteLLM), RAG, multi-provider model routing and voice (STT/TTS).
Automated RAG quality evaluation (LLM-as-judge) with dataset generation at ingestion.
Document validation with multimodal models and ongoing provider comparison (Gemini, Claude and GPT).
GCP data platform (BigQuery, Dataform, Dataflow) with cost-controlled backfills and alerting, plus the API that serves that context, encrypted, to the assistants.
Internal app to govern AI use cases, with LLM pre-assessment, from architecture to demos with the business.
Agents that turn a phone call into structured data (Whisper + Gemini) and hybrid (rules + LLM) PDF extraction.
Business automations in production and quality standards for the team's repositories (tests, SAST, CVEs and CI).
GitOps on multi-cluster GKE, GitLab CI/CD and observability with OpenTelemetry and New Relic.
AI-assisted development with Claude Code (agents, skills) and multi-model review before critical changes.
Stack: Python, FastAPI, Google ADK, LiteLLM, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataform, Dataflow, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Firestore, Oracle, GKE, GitLab CI/CD.
experience.headline: Applied AI end to end: assistants, documents, data and operations.

experience.summary: Focused on backend specialization (Java/Spring) while owning cloud/data integrations and frontend support.
highlights: Strategic Middleware APIs: Designed and developed Spring-based middleware to optimize frontend/external services communication.
GKE Migration & Optimization: Led the migration to Google Kubernetes Engine, automating continuous delivery and optimizing deployments.
Post-Merger Data Integration: Actively participated in the data integration after the Preving/Cualtis merger, performing mapping and application adaptation.
International Experience (Dublin, 2022): Spent 3 months working remotely from Ireland, improving English fluency and adaptability in global environments.
Stack: Java, Spring Framework, Angular, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, GitLab CI/CD.
experience.headline: Java/Spring backend leading GKE migration and CI/CD.

experience.summary: Intensive training and first contact with professional web development environments.
highlights: Received intensive training in Java Spring, Angular, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Participated in agile development teams, contributing to real-world projects and learning full software lifecycles.
